$Comment: The Santa Suit's costume: for thirty minutes the wearer takes the game's Santa look (the model NPC_Santa). It changes the model and is no debuff, which is what makes it a costume: the wearer can take it off any time with /zigcostume off, and no second costume goes over it. Using a Santa Suit (Christmas_Santa_Suit) puts it on the player who used it. Its picture on the buff bar is the suit's own red wool. Duration is in seconds; the suit's description in items.lang writes it out (30:00), so change it with this.
Name: christmas.world.effect.christmas_costume_santa.name
